timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,600 KRW/USD (or higher)

WHY: The headline indicates the won is weakening toward 1,600 KRW per dollar despite five rounds of verbal intervention and maximum foreign currency supply measures by authorities. A weak won (high KRW/USD ratio) makes your monthly $2,000 conversion more expensive in won terms, and the trend appears to be deteriorating further.

TIP: Consider accelerating conversions or using forward contracts if available, since the won weakness appears persistent despite government efforts to support it.
